OXY.headline: Goldman Sachs Maintains Buy on Occidental Petroleum, Raises Price Target to $76
Piper Sandler Assumes Occidental Petroleum at Neutral, Announces Price Target of $69
Analyst Actions: Goldman Sachs and Piper Sandler Update Occidental Petroleum Price Targets
OXY.summary: Goldman Sachs and Piper Sandler have both adjusted their price targets for Occidental Petroleum.

OXY.headline: Goldman Sachs Adjusts Price Target on Occidental Petroleum
OXY.summary: Goldman Sachs has updated its price target for Occidental Petroleum, moving it from $69 to $76.

OXY.headline: Goldman Sachs Downgrades Occidental Petroleum to Neutral
OXY.summary: Goldman Sachs has downgraded Occidental Petroleum Corporation to a 'neutral' rating.

OXY.headline: Chuck Schumer Says Americans Paid ‘Billions More for Gas’ as Trump Profited From Oil Stocks; White House Insists Low Prices Are ‘Priority’
OXY.summary: Chuck Schumer accused Donald Trump of profiting from oil and gas stocks while Americans pay more for gas, vowing to hold him accountable.

OXY.headline: Occidental Petroleum Declares Quarterly Dividend
OXY.summary: Occidental Petroleum Corporation has declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.28 per share on its common stock.
